title: Approver Lens: compact access-review cards with cost & timeline context
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Design a compact, scannable 'Approver Lens' UI for the Redwood Console access-review workflow. The goal is to let workspace admins and approvers quickly assess who has access, why the grant exists (role/policy), recent changes in the audit timeline, and the approximate cost exposure of that access — all from a single card list without drilling into the full audit record. The feature should support bulk actions (revoke/flag), in-line justification capture, and a lightweight diff to show permission changes over time.
acceptance_criteria: Compact card list shows principal name, role, grant reason, last changed timestamp, and a micro-cost indicator (estimated monthly token cost band)
Clicking a card expands an inline timeline (3 most recent events) with links to full audit record and related PR/drive artifacts
Bulk-select + action menu supports revoke/flag/assign temporary expiration with confirmation and optional justification capture
Cards include accessibility labels, keyboard navigation, and clear focus states for screen readers
Design integrates with existing console Rollouts and Cost views: cost indicator links to the per-route cost breakdown for the role's top routes
design_notes: Trade-offs: dense vs discoverable — we favor a compact default list (2 lines) with affordances to expand; heavy details move to the expanded pane to keep scanning fast
Cost indicator is an ordinal band (Low / Medium / High) derived from route attribution; not a precise charge — explicit tooltip explains methodology
Timeline preview shows 3 most relevant events (grant, last usage spike, recent change) to minimize noise; full audit opens in audit explorer
Considerations for multi-workspace views: include workspace badge and allow filtering by workspace without switching context
Security: justification capture should be optional but persisted to audit logs when present; trigger security_review_required flag for any cross-workspace grants
